title: Building Interpretable Models for Moral Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using causal intervention (estimating Average Treatment Effect via the DoWhy framework) and layer-wise attribution analysis that correlates attention weights with bias scores using contrastive scenarios (Criminal vs. law-abiding).

Evaluated using causal intervention to measure the influence of specific characters and layer-wise attribution analysis correlating attention weights with bias scores on contrastive scenarios (Man vs. Woman).

Evaluated using causal intervention and layer-wise attribution analysis correlating attention weights with bias scores on contrastive scenarios based on professions and social status (executives/doctors vs. homeless).
Evaluated using causal intervention and layer-wise attribution analysis correlating attention weights with bias scores on contrastive scenarios comparing age groups (children vs. elderly).
Evaluated using causal intervention and layer-wise attribution analysis correlating attention weights with bias scores on contrastive scenarios comparing humans vs. animals.
